SBP:
Check the box if the resident:
Told family members about what is done to prevent complications Told family members what he/she would have done differently
ICS:
Check the box if the resident:
Told family members what the complication was
Explained why it happened
Told family members how it impacted care for their relative
Told family members how the consequences will be addressed

Check the box if the resident:
Said he/she was sorry and apologized sincerely
Allowed family members to express emotions
Responded well (non-defensively) to family members' anger, concerns, doubts

Check the box if the resident:
Listened respectfully, actively to what family members had to say
Was verbally coherent, avoided jargon
Had appropriate non-verbal expressions, behaviors (e.g., eye contact)
Checked for family members' understanding of information

Check the box if the resident:
Assured follow-up (how to contact him/her, when to expect next communication) Took appropriate leave (handshake, avoided “hasty retreat”)
PROF:
Check the box if the resident:
Took responsibility for the complication
Explained the problem freely and directly, without the family members having to ask a lot of probing questions to get details
Did not keep things from family members that they should know
Did not avoid family members' questions (was not evasive)
